name: USD/JPY Reaction to BOJ Rate Decisions
description: Analyzes how USD/JPY moves in the 5 trading days after BOJ rate decisions. Detects hike events (≥0.05% change in Japan call money rate, IRSTCI01JPM156N) vs holds. Compares average 5-day return, hit rate, and distribution of outcomes between hike and hold regimes. Includes event markers for each BOJ hike.
source:
# =============================================================================
# USD/JPY REACTION TO BOJ RATE DECISIONS
# =============================================================================
# Signal: Japan call money rate (IRSTCI01JPM156N, monthly)
#   — Hike: month-over-month change >= 0.05% (5bps)
#   — Hold: rate published but change < 0.05%
# Outcome: 5-day forward return on USD/JPY after each decision month
# Note: Monthly FRED data is indexed by observation date (the month itself).
#   is_valid() correctly identifies each monthly observation as a decision bar.
#   No calendar mismatch — we're detecting the rate change, not a release date.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# BOJ RATE DATA & REGIME CLASSIFICATION
# =============================================================================

boj_data = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01JPM156N')()
boj_val = boj_data.result
had_boj = is_valid(boj_val)

# Prior month's rate (most recent past observation)
prior_boj = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_boj, boj_val)
boj_change = boj_val - prior_boj

# Regime classification: hike >= 5bps, hold = valid but below threshold
is_hike = had_boj and is_valid(boj_change) and (boj_change >= 0.05)
is_hold = had_boj and is_valid(boj_change) and (boj_change < 0.05)

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS (5-day USD/JPY return after decision)
# =============================================================================

# 5-day forward return on USD/JPY price
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)

# Regime-filtered forward returns (NaN on non-event bars)
h_fwd5 = where(is_hike, fwd_5d)
hold_fwd5 = where(is_hold, fwd_5d)

# =============================================================================
# HIT RATE (ternary pattern — S41: avoids where-literal 100% trap)
# =============================================================================

# Hike hit rate: USD/JPY rose (positive return) after hike
h_win = 1.0 if (is_hike and is_valid(fwd_5d) and fwd_5d > 0) else 0.0
h_win_clean = h_win if is_hike else 0.0

# Hold hit rate: USD/JPY rose after hold
hold_win = 1.0 if (is_hold and is_valid(fwd_5d) and fwd_5d > 0) else 0.0
hold_win_clean = hold_win if is_hold else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKER HELPERS
# =============================================================================

h_change_bps = where(is_hike, boj_change * 100)   # rate change in bps for display
h_rate_level = where(is_hike, boj_val)             # rate level at hike

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS — Narrative arc: Table → Bar chart → Boxplot → Event markers
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Summary Table: Key stats for hike vs hold ---
# Standard mode: 8 cells (2 rows × 4 cols)
# Row 0: Hike stats | Row 1: Hold stats
# Cols: Event Count | Avg 5d Return | Median 5d Return | Hit Rate (% USD/JPY up)
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BOJ Decision Impact on USD/JPY (5-Day Forward Return)',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Hike (>=5bps)', 'Hold'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Avg 5d Return', 'Median 5d Return', 'Hit Rate (USD/JPY Up)'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Hike
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 1: Hold
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='BOJ Impact',
    order=0
)(h_fwd5, h_fwd5, h_fwd5, h_win_clean, hold_fwd5, hold_fwd5, hold_fwd5, hold_win_clean)

# --- 2. Bar Chart: Average 5-day return — hike vs hold ---
xy_bars(
    title='BOJ Hikes Tend to Strengthen JPY (USD/JPY Falls)',
    category='BOJ Impact',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg 5-Day Return',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='No Change')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hike (>=5bps)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hold', color=Color.Gray)
    ])
)(h_fwd5, hold_fwd5)

# --- 3. Boxplot: Distribution of 5-day returns — hike vs hold ---
boxplot(
    title='Distribution of USD/JPY 5-Day Returns After BOJ Decisions',
    category='BOJ Impact',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='5-Day Return',
    show_outliers=True,
    whisker_iqr=1.5,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    median_color=Color.White,
    series_names=['Hike (>=5bps)', 'Hold'],
    order=2
)(h_fwd5, hold_fwd5)

# --- 4. Event Markers: Each BOJ hike ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BOJ Rate Hike',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Rate Change (bps)',
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='BOJ Rate Level (%)',
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='USD/JPY 5d Return',
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_hike, h_change_bps, h_rate_level, h_fwd5)
